slug: 2026-04-01 State of Internet Freedom in Zambia 2026 6th Edition

facts.fact: Bloggers of Zambia reports that the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner became operational, with a registration deadline of 30 April 2025.

Bloggers of Zambia reports a registration deadline of 30 April 2025 under the Data Protection Act for data controllers and processors, with the Commissioner's office operational; no decision or sanction is stated.

systems.owner: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner
